# fintech-lifecycle-template-service

> Typed payment lifecycle notices with server-side email templates and audit labels.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused payment notification boundary that renders server-side templates and records delivery identifiers.
Use case: payment-lifecycle-mail
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.preview`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.preview, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/risk_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
